title: Updating the register coordinate function
statement: Let $e$ be a record whose eleven natural-number fields, in order, are the circuit-input count, hard-wired-bit count, step budget, current instruction, preceding cell, first instruction of the current step, two loop counters, hard-wired and free input positions, and scratch space. Let $f(e)$ be the function on slots $0$ through $10$ that lists these fields in that order, and let setting slot $r$ to $v$ replace the corresponding field of $e$. Updating $f(e)$ at any slot $r$ to the value $v$ gives the coordinate function of the record obtained by setting slot $r$ to $v$.
